title: lem-weil-pbc-etale-inverse-image-abelian-lift-hom
statement: Let U,V be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f : U → V, L the set inverse image on the small étale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], La the abelian inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], and FaU,FaV the forgetful functors from abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Assume L preserves finite limits. There exists ea : La ⋙ FaU ≅ FaV ⋙ L such that forgetting every adjunct under the abelian inverse/direct-image adjunction [def-weil-pbc-direct-image] equals the set adjunct after precomposing with ea inverse. No operation compatibility is asserted.

source.place: Proposition 00YV, proof of (2) and its paragraph on rings; discussion of quadruples and sextuples in Section 00YR; Example 00X2 and uniqueness of adjoints

proof.text: The base-change functor is continuous. The recorded set inverse image is left adjoint to its sectionwise set direct image by Mathlib.sheafAdjunctionContinuous. The assumed finite-limit preservation implies finite-product preservation.

Use the abelian clause of the sheaf/internal-object identification on the source and target sites; its section formulas identify the structure maps with the actual sectionwise operations. Apply the corresponding clause of the product-preserving lifted adjunction to the set adjunction.

Transport the lifted adjunction through the inverse sheaf/internal-object functors. Its right lift evaluates at base-changed objects and hence has exactly the sectionwise operations and restriction maps of the recorded direct image. The resulting right forgetful comparison is the identity; restrict the hom-set equations of the generic lift accordingly.

Compare the transported left adjoint with Etale.upperStar, another left adjoint of the same abelian direct image, using the unique isomorphism compatible with the adjunctions. Composing its underlying comparison with that of the internal-object lift gives ea. The compatibility of adjunction bijections gives precisely the displayed hom-set equation.

lean.statement:
theorem etaleInverseImageAbelianLift_hom (U V : Scheme.{u}) (f : U ⟶ V)
    (hL : PreservesFiniteLimits (Scheme.etaleSetPullback f)) :
    let b := MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f
    let L := Scheme.etaleSetPullback f
    let La := Etale.upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f
    let FaU := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) U.smallEtaleTopology
    let FaV := sheafForget (D := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) V.smallEtaleTopology
    let a := Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous b
      (Type (u + 1)) (V.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
      (U.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
    ∃ (ea : La ⋙ FaU ≅ FaV ⋙ L),
        (∀ (G : Sheaf V.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
            (F : Sheaf U.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (h : La.obj G ⟶ F),
          FaV.map ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).homEquiv
            G F h) =
              a.homEquiv (FaV.obj G) (FaU.obj F) (ea.inv.app G ≫ FaU.map h))
